description: This Java class implements a FreeMarker template transformation for generating catalog URLs within the OFBiz framework, utilizing request data and category/product identifiers.

classes.name: OfbizCatalogUrlTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel that generates catalog URLs based on request and category/product parameters.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the provided map, handling SimpleScalar and GenericObjectModel types.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that processes template output, and upon closing, generates a catalog URL using request data and parameters.
